item.title: Ad Hominem
item.description:
Definition

An ad hominem argument attacks the person making an argument rather than addressing the argument itself.

Example

“Don’t listen to Sarah’s argument about climate policy. She doesn’t even have a college degree.”

Why It’s Fallacious

Sarah’s education has no bearing on whether her argument is correct. The argument should be evaluated based on its evidence and reasoning, not on characteristics of the person presenting it.
